instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
Click on 'Customize checkout' and select the 'Additional information' section from the left-hand menu.
Scroll down to the 'Return reasons' section and click on the 'Add return reason' button.
Enter a name for your new return reason in the 'Name' field, then add any additional details or instructions as needed in the 'Description' field.
Once you've created your return reason, navigate back to the Shopify theme editor by clicking on 'Online Store > Themes > Actions > Edit code'.

roi_summary: Nobody's Child will benefit from improved customer experience, reduced returns, and optimized pricing through the implementation of AI-powered solutions across various phases. The roadmap is divided into four phases: Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4) focuses on Returns Reason Capture, Automated Review Collection, Abandoned Cart Recovery Emails, and Email Marketing Automation Flows, delivering benefits such as increased customer engagement and reduced returns. Phase 2 (Weeks 5-6) introduces the Size Guide Chatbot, enhancing the customer's online shopping experience and reducing size-related returns. Phase 3 (Weeks 7-9) sees the implementation of AI Demand Forecasting and Dynamic Pricing Engine, leading to improved inventory management and pricing strategies. Finally, in Phase 4 (Weeks 10-12), Nobody's Child will realize the full potential of these solutions, with benefits including reduced forecasting errors, increased revenue, and enhanced customer satisfaction.
